ABOUT THE STORE

Rohit Departmental Store is the shop Sector 52 residents mean when they say they'll pick something up nearby.

It covers the week's vegetables, the dairy order, a tin of dry fruits for guests, a new steel tumbler, and a notebook for school — in one trip, with staff who know the shelves well enough to point customers straight to what they need.

What keeps people returning is straightforward: a genuinely wide range, held at prices that compare well against other shops in Gurugram, backed by regular discount deals on everyday essentials.
